per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support deployment on any OS that can run a supported Java runtime, including Linux, Windows, and less common enterprise flavors.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support deployment in both standard servlet containers and full Java EE or Jakarta EE application servers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete routine interactions, such as searching for a room or creating a booking, within five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve a four-nines level of availability (99.99%) during business hours, excluding planned maintenance periods.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be designed for rolling upgrades and zero-downtime deployment.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall handle at least one thousand concurrent requests at launch and scale to handle approximately two thousand concurrent requests by a subsequent release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate with enterprise mail servers using SMTP, TLS, and configurable SMTP endpoints.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall only allow authentication events against the corporate or pre-approved identity store, with no exceptions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement layered defenses, including strong input validation, parameterized queries, and a web application firewall, to prevent malicious inputs from corrupting data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall use TLS and authenticated endpoints for secure log transmission and redact personally identifiable information (PII) before transmission.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall expose readiness and liveness endpoints and instrument key business transactions for monitoring and alerting.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall use structured logs with correlation IDs for traceability and include enough context for debugging without dumping PII.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support adding new database drivers through configuration and QA tasks rather than requiring a refactor.
The system shall have an admin UI that is intuitive and does not require a PhD in enterprise software to use.
